comments:
Speech analysis atoms for recognition, transcription, and speaker identity.

## Design Philosophy

Speech analysis primitives describe the OUTPUT of speech recognition systems,
not the recognition process itself. These atoms enable agents to work with
transcribed speech, speaker characteristics, and speech timing.

## Phoneme Recognition
IPA phonemes with confidence scores enable downstream processing to handle
ambiguity appropriately. Phoneme boundaries enable precise timing.

## Word and Utterance Segmentation
Word boundaries, sentence detection, and turn-taking markers support
conversational AI applications.

## Speaker Diarization
Speaker identity, embeddings, and turn detection enable multi-speaker
transcript analysis.

## Usage
```purescript
import Hydrogen.Schema.Audio.Speech as Speech

-- Process a recognized word
word = Speech.recognizedWord
  "hello"
  (Speech.confidence 0.95)
  (Speech.wordStart 1.5)
  (Speech.wordEnd 2.1)
```

declarations.comments:
Confidence - recognition confidence score.
0.0 = no confidence (random guess), 1.0 = certain.
Values below 0.5 typically indicate unreliable recognition.
declarations.title: Confidence

declarations.comments: Create a Confidence value (clamped to 0.0-1.0)
declarations.title: confidence

declarations.comments: High confidence (0.9)
declarations.title: confidenceHigh

declarations.comments: Medium confidence (0.7)
declarations.title: confidenceMedium

declarations.comments: Low confidence (0.5)
declarations.title: confidenceLow

declarations.comments: WordStart - start time of a word in seconds from audio beginning.
declarations.title: WordStart

declarations.comments: WordEnd - end time of a word in seconds from audio beginning.
declarations.title: WordEnd

declarations.comments:
PhonemeDuration - duration of a phoneme in milliseconds.
Most phonemes are 50-200ms.
declarations.title: PhonemeDuration

declarations.comments: Create a WordStart value (clamped to non-negative)
declarations.title: wordStart

declarations.comments: Create a WordEnd value (clamped to non-negative)
declarations.title: wordEnd

declarations.comments: Create a PhonemeDuration value (clamped to 0-500)
declarations.title: phonemeDuration

declarations.comments:
IPAPhoneme - Common IPA phonemes for English speech recognition.
This is a representative subset; full IPA would have ~100+ phonemes.
declarations.title: IPAPhoneme

declarations.comments: Get IPA symbol for phoneme
declarations.title: ipaPhonemeSymbol

declarations.comments: Get category for phoneme
declarations.title: ipaPhonemeCategory

declarations.comments: PhonemeCategory - broad phoneme classification.
declarations.title: PhonemeCategory

declarations.comments: Get display name for phoneme category
declarations.title: phonemeCategoryName

declarations.comments: RecognizedPhoneme - a detected phoneme with timing and confidence.
declarations.title: RecognizedPhoneme

declarations.comments: Create a recognized phoneme record.
declarations.title: recognizedPhoneme

declarations.comments: RecognizedWord - a detected word with timing and confidence.
declarations.title: RecognizedWord

declarations.comments: Create a recognized word record.
declarations.title: recognizedWord

declarations.title: Utterance

declarations.comments: Create an utterance record.
declarations.title: utterance

declarations.comments:
SpeakerId - unique identifier for a speaker.
Used for diarization (who spoke when).
declarations.title: SpeakerId

declarations.comments:
SpeakerEmbedding - voice embedding vector for speaker identification.
Typically 128-512 dimensional vectors from speaker recognition models.
Represented as array of numbers (normalized floats).
declarations.title: SpeakerEmbedding

declarations.comments: SpeakerConfidence - confidence that a segment belongs to a speaker.
declarations.title: SpeakerConfidence

declarations.comments: Create a SpeakerId
declarations.title: speakerId

declarations.comments: Create a SpeakerEmbedding
declarations.title: speakerEmbedding

declarations.comments: Create a SpeakerConfidence value (clamped to 0.0-1.0)
declarations.title: speakerConfidence

declarations.comments: SpeakerTurn - a segment of speech from one speaker.
declarations.title: SpeakerTurn

declarations.comments: Create a speaker turn record.
declarations.title: speakerTurn

declarations.comments:
SignalToNoise - speech signal to noise ratio in dB.
Higher = cleaner audio. Below 10dB is typically problematic.
declarations.title: SignalToNoise

declarations.comments:
Intelligibility - estimated speech intelligibility score.
0.0 = unintelligible, 1.0 = perfectly clear.
Based on acoustic analysis (not transcription accuracy).
declarations.title: Intelligibility

declarations.comments: Create a SignalToNoise value (clamped to -10 to 60)
declarations.title: signalToNoise

declarations.comments: Create an Intelligibility value (clamped to 0.0-1.0)
declarations.title: intelligibility

declarations.comments:
LanguageCode - ISO 639-1 language code.
Common codes for speech recognition.
declarations.title: LanguageCode

declarations.comments: DetectedLanguage - detected language with confidence.
declarations.title: DetectedLanguage

declarations.comments: Create a detected language record.
declarations.title: detectedLanguage

declarations.comments: Get ISO 639-1 code

Bounds for Confidence

Bounds for WordStart

declarations.comments:
Bounds for WordEnd

declarations.title: wordEndBounds

declarations.comments:
